name: 1337-enhancer
description: A zero dependency chrome extension for enhancing user experience on 1337x torrent sites

scripts.dev: rimraf dist && parcel watch src/background.ts src/content.ts src/options.pug --public-url .
scripts.build: rimraf dist && parcel build --no-source-maps src/background.ts src/content.ts src/options.pug --public-url .
scripts.zip: rimraf --glob "*.zip" && npm run build && bestzip build.zip dist/* icon* manifest.json

author: rishav394
